internalCircuit.name: Dabble Add-3 Corrector
internalCircuit.description: 4-bit add-3 correction stage. IN1/OUT1 are MSB; IN4/OUT4 are LSB. Values 0-4 pass through; values 5-15 output input + 3 modulo 16.

fixedNotes: IN1/OUT1 are MSB; IN4/OUT4 are LSB.
Values 0-4 pass through; values 5-15 output input + 3 modulo 16.
The original minimized circuit behaved correctly for valid BCD inputs 0-9 but had arbitrary outputs for 10-15.

metadata.outputOrder: OUT1..OUT4 hundreds BCD, OUT5..OUT8 tens BCD, OUT9..OUT12 ones BCD; each digit MSB..LSB
